passage.label: make you recite Muhammad not forget; except Allah will Indeed knows declared hidden; ease you toward ease; remind if reminder benefit; fears Allah reminded; wretched avoid it; enter burn greatest Fire; neither dying therein nor living

arabicExcerpts.text: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ

mainSubject.label: The Prophet assured he will be made to recite without forgetting except what Allah wills, since He knows both the declared and the hidden; easing promised toward ease; the reminder commanded where it benefits, received by the God-fearing but avoided by the wretched one who will burn in the greatest Fire, neither dying therein nor living

commandsAndProhibitions.description: So remind, if the reminder should benefit.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Recitation preserved against forgetting except by divine will

relationships.label: Divine knowledge covering both the declared and the hidden

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the pasture-to-stubble cycle (5) before the recitation-and-forgetting assurance opens (6); P2 ends with the neither-dying-nor-living verdict (13) before the purification-success block begins (14); P3 runs through dhikr-prayer success, the worldly-preference rebuke and the Abrahamic-Mosaic scriptural continuity (14-19).
